design_thesis: Every new lore element must expose a lever the organism can pull when the player repeats a behavior, turning story into route locks, deck shifts, and ending gravity.

factions.deferred_secret: The procedures were tuned around her body profile from earlier entries; following them trains the organism to anticipate her restraint patterns, opening Neutral Access routes later but also letting the organism model her better.
factions.gameplay_hook: Reading/obeying a Remnant protocol applies a temporary room tag: Procedure-Active (lower danger next 2 rooms, raise corruption +1 if repeated). Unlocks ‘observe_organ_chamber’ bonus option.
factions.hymn_misread: Treats them as prior facility staff leaving practical instructions.
implementation_notes: Create a ‘procedure’ buff with 2-room duration: -1 enemy card weight, +5% access to observation actions.
Repeat within 4 rooms: add +1 corruption and flag Organism Pattern: Restraint.
Unlock Neutral ending flag if three different procedures obeyed without harvest in between.
factions.kind: defunct oversight cells embedded in bone stations
factions.name: Operator Remnants
factions.pitch: Dead procedures that still run. Their records change how routes behave if followed exactly.
factions.safe_reveal: Hymn can find bone consoles, stamped protocols, and checklists that still trigger doors and suppressors.
factions.sample_fragment: Bone console still has charge. Three steps: fix breath, mark artery, do not harvest. I follow the list. Doors listen to lists.

factions.deferred_secret: The Syndic and Merchant share ledger state. Repeated refusal increases a hidden ‘Claim’ that converts later to the Merchant Reckoning.
factions.gameplay_hook: New ‘pay_resin_toll’ event trades 5 biomass for -1 danger for 3 rooms. Refusing twice increases Merchant Claim +1 and raises hunter weight.
factions.hymn_misread: Sees it as a local toll system the Merchant reads.
implementation_notes: Track Merchant Claim (0-3). At 3, insert Merchant Reckoning card within next 3 draws.
If toll paid twice in a row, Merchant discounts next mutation by 1 biomass and offers a more intimate graft.
factions.kind: exchange sub-organ and proxy of the Merchant
factions.name: Resin Syndic
factions.pitch: Amber tax collectors that pre-price lanes. They prime the Merchant’s offers and set refusal debts.
factions.safe_reveal: Amber plaques list tolls: biomass for safe passage or leave a mark to proceed.
factions.sample_fragment: Amber plaque extrudes a slot the size of my palm. It wants price up front. I can grease the lane or carry the noise.

factions.deferred_secret: Changing baffles is a declaration of intent; repeated muting spawns a Smother Hunter that punishes stealth reliance.
factions.gameplay_hook: ‘turn_baffle’ lowers danger now, but increases chance of Smother Hunter insertion after 2 uses in 5 rooms.
factions.hymn_misread: Assumes ventilation controls to avoid pursuit.
implementation_notes: Add Smother Hunter enemy card that appears if baffles used 2+ times in last 5 rooms.
Baffle mute: -1 danger next room, +5% ambush if overused.
factions.name: Choir of Baffles
factions.pitch: Valve clusters that reroute air and scent, shaping how Hunters find Hymn.
factions.safe_reveal: Hymn can turn baffles to mute or amplify flow.
factions.sample_fragment: Baffles hum. I can choke the lane’s breath and bleed my scent sideways. Quiet buys seconds. Sometimes debts.

factions.deferred_secret: If Hymn abuses marked lanes, the Wardens adjust plates to pin and present her to a Hunter gate.
factions.gameplay_hook: Following two consecutive marked lanes grants -1 danger, but the third auto-inserts a Plate Snare event unless player breaks pattern.
factions.hymn_misread: Treats as safer corridors with clear rules.
implementation_notes: Track ‘Marked Streak’. At 3, schedule Plate Snare choice with push_through_spikes or retreat.
Breaking pattern resets streak and lowers hunter weight by 1 for 2 rooms.
factions.name: Wardens of Plate
factions.pitch: Bone-law enforcers that reward conformity to structural paths and punish improvisation.
factions.safe_reveal: Marked plate lanes are safer if walked as marked.
factions.sample_fragment: Plates show a clean line. My feet want it. The route wants me to be predictable.

factions.deferred_secret: Consulting repeatedly bonds micro-filaments that make future symbiote offers more eager and costly.
factions.gameplay_hook: ‘consult_archive’ unlocks a new symbiote option next time, but adds +1 dependence mark. Three marks trigger Director Dependence Warning.
factions.hymn_misread: Sees tactical glossaries embedded in tissue.
implementation_notes: Add Dependence Mark counter. At 3, fire director_dependence_warning.
Next symbiote host event adds a fourth, stronger option with lower max health.
factions.name: Green Archivum
factions.pitch: Vault of ancestral symbiote designs that imprint when handled.
factions.safe_reveal: Green spines hold dormant symbiote scripts that can be consulted for tactical notes.
factions.sample_fragment: Filaments twitch when I read them. The glossaries are alive enough to care that I looked.

factions.deferred_secret: Repeated rentals create a circulatory map the organism uses to pre-aim ambush swellings.
factions.gameplay_hook: ‘rent_leech’ grants +initiative next 2 combats, then auto-raises danger by +1 and schedules an ambush.
implementation_notes: Buff: +1 initiative for 2 fights; then inject an Ambush tag to the next enemy draw.
Using twice in run increases hunter weight globally by 1.
factions.name: Hemophage Guild
factions.pitch: Leeches that clean clogged lanes by drinking pressure and selling it back as speed.
factions.safe_reveal: Attach one to lighten footwork; it steals later.
factions.sample_fragment: The leech tests my pulse with tiny teeth. I let it drink a timing window and buy my next step.

guardrails: Never state clone truth in narration; imply through tailored procedures and déjà vu.
Chorus never speaks on-screen; use Hymn’s requests and report acts only.
Merchant is patient and predatory; no friendly banter or jokes; all upsides have deferred cost.
Lore fragments must alter future rooms, deck weights, or thresholds; no pure flavor.
Hunters must tie to player behavior patterns; avoid random spawns without a breadcrumb.
Corruption power must feel useful first, invasive later; always show a late cost.
Refusal and retreat accumulate debt or danger; refusal is never free.
Symbiote dependence escalates organism learning; do not make repeat bonds purely optimal.

lore_fragments.deferred_secret: Repeating the ritual three times in a run teaches the organism to pulse in her cadence.
lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: On read, add option ‘mark_red_branch’ with extra -1 danger this room; do it 3 times: +1 corruption and schedule Director Safety Warning.
implementation_notes: Attach a temporary status ‘Lockout Synced’ for 2 rooms; third application triggers warning event.
lore_fragments.name: Bone Lockout Tag
lore_fragments.safe_reveal: Following the steps calms the corridor for two rooms.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Bone tag still warm. I do what it says. The room approves.

lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: Unlock ‘pay_resin_toll’. Pay: -1 danger for 3 rooms. Skip twice: +1 Claim and +hunter weight.
lore_fragments.hymn_misread: Bribe to keep the lane from yelling.
implementation_notes: Add UI action in amber corridors when script found.
lore_fragments.name: Resin Toll Script
lore_fragments.pitch: Amber veins list toll exchange rates.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Rates are carved into the resin. They assume I brought enough to bleed.

lore_fragments.deferred_secret: Using it twice marks her rhythm; third time adds Director Corruption Warning.
lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: First read unlocks observe. Second reduces boss ambush. Third adds +1 corruption.
implementation_notes: Track memo uses across run.
lore_fragments.name: Echo Technician Memo
lore_fragments.pitch: Short note about hanging-heart timing windows.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Two-count on the downbeat. Cut on the up. I can hear it now.

lore_fragments.deferred_secret: Three repeats in five rooms push ending gravity decisively.
lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: Repeat path type: +biomass +3 now; add either Corruption +1 (if green/gift path) or Hunter weight +1 (if red/avoid path).
implementation_notes: Mark path categories and count recent repeats.
lore_fragments.name: Spindle Oath
lore_fragments.safe_reveal: Repeating branch grants a small boon.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Stone-bone letters promise an easier walk if I make the same mistake twice.

lore_fragments.deferred_secret: Stacking stubs lets Hunters triangulate her lane.
lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: On pickup, reveal a countdown—after 2 rooms: Ambush. Two stubs: +1 global hunter weight.
implementation_notes: Visual countdown in UI; on zero, enqueue ambush event.
lore_fragments.name: Leech Rental Stub
lore_fragments.safe_reveal: Shows when the payback bite lands.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Stub hooks into my wrist and starts a quiet timer.

lore_fragments.gameplay_hook: First use: -2 danger next room. Use again within 3 rooms: schedule Smother Hunter.
implementation_notes: Add internal cooldown tracker for safe vs punished use.
lore_fragments.name: Baffle Maplet
lore_fragments.pitch: Diagram of valves and scent currents.
lore_fragments.sample_fragment: Lines show where breath goes when I twist a single bone wheel.

mechanic_hooks: Verb counters: fight, flee, harvest, file, mutate, consult (symbiote). Each has warning and lock thresholds.
Merchant Claim ledger tied to refusals and resin toll scripts, leading to Merchant Reckoning.
Baffle control action with Smother Hunter punishment on repetition.
Marked Route streak that grants safety then triggers Plate Snare.
Dependence Marks from symbiote archive consults; gates Director Dependence Warning and stronger offers.
Field Report system: lower variance now, schedule tailored enemy later.
Leech Rental countdown: temporary speed, guaranteed future ambush.
Spindle-path repetition micro-boons that push ending gravity.
next_lore_prompt: Design three new room events that implement: 1) Resin Toll Script with pay/skip consequences, 2) Baffle control with Smother Hunter setup, 3) Plate Snare trap after marked-lane streak. Each event must include actions using existing verbs or clearly call out any needed new handlers, a short Hymn narration pair, and explicit deck/danger/corruption adjustments and warning/lock scheduling.
notes: Accepted first-pass lore architecture: Operator Remnants, Resin Syndic, Baffles, Wardens of Plate, Green Archivum, Hemophage Guild, Chorus Field Office, Blood Ledger, Echo Technician, Spindle-Keeper. Build future content around short-term benefit, repeated-pattern warning, and ending pressure.

organism_lore.deferred_secret: It can prepare a room for an unmade choice if her pressure shape predicts it.
organism_lore.gameplay_hook: Deck mutators watch action verbs and insert specific counter rooms after thresholds.
organism_lore.hymn_misread: Thinks it keys off heat and noise only.
implementation_notes: Implement verb counters: fight, flee, harvest, file_report. Each has a warning, then a lock room.
organism_lore.name: Pressure Memory
organism_lore.pitch: The organism records not events but pressure shapes: flight, fight, feed, file.
organism_lore.safe_reveal: Repeated behaviors change room timing and target selection.
organism_lore.sample_fragment: It answers choices, not words. My hands teach it what to bring next.

organism_lore.deferred_secret: The organism infers what limits she’ll cross; extreme consent unlocks Corruption Claim.
organism_lore.gameplay_hook: After 3 mutations, inject Director Corruption Warning; after 5, increase mutation discounts but lock certain neutral routes.
organism_lore.hymn_misread: Sees the Merchant curating stock to her body.
implementation_notes: Mutation count gates narrative variants and removes some ‘observe’ choices past threshold.
organism_lore.name: Graft Appetite
organism_lore.pitch: Every mutation is a consent signal to reshape more.
organism_lore.safe_reveal: Mutations change offers and narration tone.
organism_lore.sample_fragment: The offers track me like a measuring tape with teeth.

organism_lore.deferred_secret: Ledger-congruent peristalsis routes her to a scale room if pressure remains unpaid.
organism_lore.gameplay_hook: Refusal Streak >=2: insert Danger Warning; >=3: force Hunter or Merchant Reckoning.
organism_lore.hymn_misread: Thinks the noise of leaving is what draws hunters.
implementation_notes: Track refusal and retreat; add Blood Ledger hunter or Merchant Reckoning accordingly.
organism_lore.name: Debt Peristalsis
organism_lore.pitch: Refusals and retreats create a backflow the system resolves with Hunters or the Merchant.
organism_lore.sample_fragment: Leaving saves blood now and spends it later with interest.

recurring_characters.deferred_secret: He accrues Claim across runs via behavior patterns; Syndic and debt marks feed his ledger.
recurring_characters.gameplay_hook: Debt counters from refusals raise danger and unlock a forced ‘merchant_reckoning’. Discount hooks when you overpay tolls.
recurring_characters.hymn_misread: Assumes he tracks scent and timing.
implementation_notes: Expose Merchant Claim and Refusal counters to director systems only.
Add special discounted mutation if toll paid twice in past 5 rooms.
recurring_characters.name: The Merchant
recurring_characters.pitch: He prices refusal and memory. He arrives when lanes feel most private.
recurring_characters.safe_reveal: Trades biomass for mutations; remembers prior choices this run.
recurring_characters.sample_fragment: Scales open before he speaks. Prices already written like I agreed earlier.

recurring_characters.deferred_secret: It follows a path of unpaid exchanges; killing it reduces Merchant Claim by 1 once per run.
recurring_characters.gameplay_hook: Spawn condition based on retreat/refusal streak; on kill, reduce Claim; on flee, schedule Reckoning sooner.
recurring_characters.hymn_misread: A bigger, angrier hunter keyed to her heat.
implementation_notes: Insert if merchant_refusal_limit exceeded or retreat used 3 times in 5 rooms.
recurring_characters.name: Hunter: Blood Ledger
recurring_characters.safe_reveal: Appears after strings of refusals and retreats.
recurring_characters.sample_fragment: It wears old resin on its shins like badges. It knows the places I said no.

recurring_characters.deferred_secret: Her routines were written for Hymn’s profile; following them accelerates Organism Pattern Lock if abused.
recurring_characters.gameplay_hook: Reading 2+ Echo logs adds ‘observe’ action variants and reduces enemy ambush, but repeat use adds Corruption +1.
recurring_characters.hymn_misread: Another field tech who walked smart.
implementation_notes: Tag ‘Echo-read’ rooms to add observation options; stack 3 triggers Director Corruption Warning.
recurring_characters.kind: ghosted operator presence in records and mechanisms
recurring_characters.name: Echo Technician
recurring_characters.pitch: Her logs anticipate operations near cores.
recurring_characters.safe_reveal: Short, precise notes improve approach options.
recurring_characters.sample_fragment: Her checklist matches my hands without needing edits. That’s not normal.

recurring_characters.deferred_secret: It trains her into an ending: Corruption if she accepts gifts, Hunter if she avoids.
recurring_characters.gameplay_hook: If player repeats last choice type at splits, grant immediate small boon and push ending axis.
implementation_notes: Track Last Route Intent; if matched, give +biomass or -danger micro-reward and increase relevant ending weight.
recurring_characters.name: Spindle-Keeper
recurring_characters.pitch: Offers soft reroutes that favor pattern continuation.
recurring_characters.safe_reveal: Hymn feels guided at forks; smoother if she keeps doing the same.
recurring_characters.sample_fragment: The right-hand lane feels cut for my stride. It would be easy to take it again.

relationships.gameplay_expression: File Report reduces variance now but schedules tailored counters later.
relationships.hidden_truth: Chorus anticipates her injuries and routes; it studies outcomes more than survival.
relationships.visible_relationship: Hymn files reports and requests authorizations; Chorus remains silent in text.

relationships.gameplay_expression: Verb counters mutate deck; warnings precede locks and endings.
relationships.hidden_truth: It models her pressure shape and prepares unchosen rooms.
relationships.visible_relationship: It reacts to noise, harvest, and hesitation.

relationships.gameplay_expression: Refusal/Debt counters raise danger and schedule Merchant Reckoning.
relationships.hidden_truth: Ledger shares state with amber tolls; Claim accrues to forced reckoning.

relationships.gameplay_expression: Dependence marks increase corruption pressure and alter future symbiote offers.
relationships.hidden_truth: Their eagerness scales with her dependence; they teach her limits to the organism.
relationships.visible_relationship: Tools that aid Hymn at a cost.

relationships.gameplay_expression: Spawn Smother Hunter or Plate Snare when patterns persist.
relationships.hidden_truth: Overuse of quiet lanes or marked routes manufactures specific hunter spawns.

reveal_paths.early_reveal: Clean directives implied by report prompts; Field Office bones accept telemetry.
reveal_paths.ending_connection: Neutral ending eligibility improves with selective filing, harms with spam (organism anticipation).
reveal_paths.late_reveal: Pre-filed feeling: responses seem ready for wounds not yet taken this run.
reveal_paths.mid_reveal: Reports near cores cause rooms to pre-adjust to her last injuries.
reveal_paths.player_pressure: File to calm variance vs avoid to keep surprise on her side.

reveal_paths.ending_connection: Spindle Oath pushes toward Corruption or Hunter endings.
reveal_paths.late_reveal: Prepared rooms for unmade choices; splits that reward staying in pattern.
reveal_paths.mid_reveal: Deck adjustments after repeated verbs; director warnings fire.

reveal_paths.ending_connection: Merchant Reckoning as variant of danger/ownership outcome.
reveal_paths.late_reveal: Merchant Reckoning seals routes; ownership asserted.
reveal_paths.mid_reveal: Resin tolls adjust offers; Claim rises on avoidance.
reveal_paths.player_pressure: Pay to lower danger now or save biomass and face debt/hunter weight.

reveal_paths.ending_connection: Neutral access unlocked if varied use; Corruption if abused.
reveal_paths.late_reveal: Procedures match her exactly; unease grows without clone text.
reveal_paths.mid_reveal: Shorter narration and better observe windows on repeat rooms.
reveal_paths.player_pressure: Use the perfect-fit notes to gain control at the cost of organism learning.

summary: Add concrete pressure sources that react to repeated player patterns: an Operator Remnant network, a Resin Syndic (merchant sub-organ), and Hunters with named subtypes. Lore fragments unlock room tags, alter deck weights, and set up future endings like Merchant Reckoning and Neutral Access. All samples keep Hymn ignorant of the clone truth and Chorus unheard.
